import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Get the existing table
docs = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create an embedding index on the "content" column using the
# sentence-transformers UDF (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model)
docs.add_embedding_index(
    'content',
    string_embed=sentence_transformer.using(model_id='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
)

# Run a nearest-neighbor similarity query
query = "climate change policy"
sim = docs.content.similarity(query)

results = (
    docs.order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .select(docs.content, similarity=sim)
    .collect()
)

print(results)

import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Get the existing table
docs = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create an embedding index on the "content" column using the
# sentence-transformers UDF (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model)
docs.add_embedding_index(
    'content',
    string_embed=sentence_transformer.using(model_id='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
)

# Run a nearest-neighbor similarity query
query = "climate change policy"
sim = docs.content.similarity(query)

results = (
    docs.order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .select(docs.content, similarity=sim)
    .collect()
)

print(results)
